topography.project_purpose: Structural profile: 52 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 3 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 18 common project-authored base contract(s) (cumulativepremiumfractions, claimableamountmanager, limitordermanager). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
